【原视频简介】
Days before BlizzCon 2026, the official StarCraft website started glitching, and it is clearly deliberate. Hidden in the page are records dated 2575, partially redacted names and references to StarCraft lore, all pointing at some kind of reveal on September 12.

This video goes through what is actually known so far: the website teaser, the hour-long gap in the BlizzCon day-one schedule, the reports about a Blizzard-made StarCraft shooter, and the Korean reports about Nexon developing a new StarCraft game. StarCraft 3 is not the only possibility here, and what gets announced matters for the future of StarCraft 2.
